name: Holy Shield
description: Wraps an ally within %cast_range% tiles in a %barrier_hp% health barrier for %duration% turns.
details: If the barrier is broken before it fades it erupts, clearing the ally's debuffs and dealing %damage% damage to enemies within %radius% tile.

upgrade.summary: A %barrier_hp% barrier that mends %barrier_regen% a turn and always erupts.
details: The barrier regains %barrier_regen% at the start of each turn, up to its full %barrier_hp%, for as long as it has not been broken.
It erupts whether it is broken or simply fades, clearing the ally's debuffs and dealing %damage% damage to enemies within %radius% tile either way.
